visual.general_description: Single close-up slit lamp style color photograph of an eye with an irregular whitish-grey patch beside the pupil.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph of an eye framed by upper lid lashes at the top and a pink lower lid at the bottom, with a black area in the upper right corner. A large dark round pupil with a bright white reflection on its left side sits in a brown iris with fine radial texture, surrounded by a clear grey-green ring at the iris edge. Left of the pupil, on the iris-level surface, is an irregular elongated whitish-grey patch with a yellow-green tinge in its middle. A thin green line runs along the lower lid margin, and yellow-orange tint is visible on the tissue at the left edge and along the lower border of the eye. No printed text, panel letters, arrows, scale bars or dates are visible.
